text:
Type: TV bench with sliding glass doors
Use: holding a TV, displaying and storing media and games; living room, family room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: black-stained wood veneer with visible grain, tinted glass sliding doors, brass-tone recessed pulls
Colors: deep black, smoky glass, gold accents
Shape: long low cabinet with two framed glass sliding doors, small brass pulls at the ends, overhanging top with a cable slot, molded plinth base, solid and elongated, heavy visual weight
Feel: elegant, dark, refined, formal
Goes with: white or grey walls, brass accents, dark wood, warm rugs; classic or traditional living rooms
